The '''Bantha Boutique''' was a gift shop located in [[Bantha Traxx]]. The boutique sold [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], toys and other merchandise, all of which carried the Bantha Traxx logo. Children of all [[Species/Legends|species]] loved the [[stuffed bantha]]s sold in the store.<ref name="WHSV" />
